title: Concept: Dynamic evaluation via DRb.start_service (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, DRb.start_service resolves, renders or loads at runtime, so a value that reaches it selects the code path or markup that is produced. The remedy is an explicit branch over known operations with escaping (no DRb or local-only ACL).
applicability: ruby dynamic calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution or XSS; HIGH severity.
